excluded_from_this_asset.mineral_cover: The barrier the heave creates is a SEPARATE asset with its own budget (card .MESH_PROP). It is not built here and not counted in these triangles. This asset provides only the motion and the Cover_Cast_Origin socket the runtime places it from.

foot_planting.why: Stubby vertical legs on flat foot plates: any rotation in the chain swings a plate corner underground. Each foot is counter-rotated by the negation of everything above it, and the residual is removed by raising the body. These lifts are MEASURED on the posed mesh, not dialled in by eye.

gait_separation.cairnback: lateral sequence, one limb at a time, 270 cm/s
gait_separation.why: the owner asked for a different stance AND gait, so the phase pattern differs deliberately

material_slot_policy: Two slots: layered strata for the shell, limbs and head, and amber restricted to the seams between shell courses. The back is armour, not a lamp.

rig.policy: The card's heavy low-slung plan: four thick limb chains, a short protected neck, and a back-slab chain that flexes on the heave. Weighted toward the limbs and the back, the inverse of the Resonant's plan and unlike the Riftstalker's long-limbed one. No root motion.

scale_basis.basis: larger than the Riftstalker's 201 x 295, as a population-3 assault unit against a population-2 skirmisher
scale_basis.canon: SPEC-UNIT-007: a broad, low assault warform whose back is a slab of layered heat-holding strata; thick forelimbs; head low and protected

silhouette_first.directive: Owner ruling 2026-09-07: establish a contrasting silhouette BEFORE detailing.
silhouette_first.how: The shell profile was defined first and everything else was fitted under it. The two contrast measures below are asserted by test, and a monochrome tactical comparison against the Riftstalker's rendered baseline is produced as evidence rather than asserted.

measures.requirement: distinguishable in MONOCHROME at tactical distance (owner ruling 2026-09-07)
